svg.aria-label: Three bars for five contracts of a hypothetical 24-month XYZ 40 call on a 50,000 account. The premium paid, which is the most the position can lose, is 7,790, or 15.6 percent of the account. The share-equivalent exposure at a delta of 0.82 is 410 shares, or 20,500, 41 percent of the account. The notional value of the 500 shares the contracts control is 25,000, 50 percent of the account.
svg.text: Five contracts, one position, three sizes
Hypothetical 24-month XYZ 40 call at 15.58, XYZ at 50, account of 50,000
